cars.name: Family sedan
cars.basis: A mid-size four-cylinder family sedan as US magazines test them: 0-60 about 7.2 s, 60-0 about 122 ft, 0.86 g on the skidpad, about 3,400 lb (1,560 kg) plus the driver, 111 in (2.83 m) wheelbase, 60% of the weight on the front tires, top speed about 124 mph. Soft springs, modern stability control.

cars.name: Muscle car
cars.basis: A V8 muscle coupe (about 460 hp, rear drive) as US magazines test them: 0-60 about 4.4 s, 0-100 about 9-10 s, 60-0 about 106 ft, 0.95 g on the skidpad, about 3,850 lb (1,750 kg) plus the driver, 107 in (2.72 m) wheelbase, 53% front, lower center of gravity, top speed limited to 155 mph. Firmer springs and more squat at the rear; stability control in its sport setting lets the tail out further before it steps in.

cars.name: Pickup truck
cars.basis: A full-size half-ton crew-cab pickup with a V8 and a ten-speed automatic as US magazines test them: 0-60 about 6.3 s, 60-0 about 133 ft, 0.76 g on the skidpad, about 5,200 lb (2,350 kg) plus the driver, 145 in (3.68 m) wheelbase, 58% front, a high center of gravity, slower steering, and a speed governor at about 107 mph. Soft, bouncy springs (leaf springs at the back, empty bed).
